facts.fact: INTIC presented on 23 October 2026 in Maputo a proposal to revise Decree 67/2017, raising the guiding principles from 10 to 15; the revision is proposed, not adopted.

INTIC's post describes Decree No. 67/2017 of 1 December as approving the regulation of the e-government interoperability framework, guiding how the state's electronic systems and services interoperate.
INTIC presented on 23 October 2026 a proposed revision of Decree 67/2017, not yet adopted.

INTIC's post says the proposed revision of Decree 67/2017, presented on 23 October 2026, sets out technical specifications, architecture and interoperability standards for the state's systems; it is proposed, not adopted.
